packs.name: Bioicons
packs.summary: 2,830 science icons covering chemistry, cell biology, lab equipment, sequencing and clinical imagery, contributed by many authors. Strong on epigenetics: histones, nucleosomes, 5mC and 5hmC, chromatin states and Tn5 for ATAC. Most icons ask for attribution and a few are share-alike, both flagged in the sidebar.

packs.name: SciDraw
packs.summary: 609 community-contributed scientific drawings with a DOI and a named author on each. Strongest on whole animals and neuroscience: mice, rats, zebrafish, flies and birds, brains and behavioural setups, plus a large set of cells. Material neither BioArt nor Bioicons covers. Every drawing is CC BY or CC0, and none is share-alike.

packs.name: PhyloPic
packs.summary: 11,078 silhouettes of organisms across the tree of life, filed by clade: mammals, birds, reptiles, fish, insects, molluscs, plants, fungi, bacteria and more. Made for model organisms, evolution and ecology figures, which the molecular libraries do not cover. Every silhouette is CC0, Public Domain or CC BY, with its contributor recorded; non-commercial and share-alike ones are left out.

packs.name: Reactome Icons
packs.summary: 2,257 pathway icons from the Reactome Icon Library: receptors, transporters, channels, complexes, compounds, cell types and tissues, plus the reaction arrows a pathway diagram is made of. The molecular vocabulary BioArt and Bioicons are thin on. Every icon is CC BY 4.0 with a named designer, and none is share-alike.

packs.name: Health Icons
packs.summary: 749 public health pictograms: clinics and wards, staff and patients, devices and diagnostics, medicines and vaccines, symptoms, body parts and disease vectors. Flat and diagrammatic, made for study designs, clinical workflows and consort-style figures. Every icon is CC0, so nothing here needs crediting.
